prompts.Poses: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D fighting game full-body sprite atlas. Input image: reference only, attached C4-621 motion/design sheet from Armored Core VI. Create NEW clean high-detail game sprites of C4-621's LOADER 4, faithfully matching the reference: industrial weathered warm gray/off-white and dark graphite bipedal armored mech, small rectangular orange sensor head, broad angular shoulders, narrow mechanical waist, articulated reverse-looking human biped knees and heavy feet, right hand RF-024 TURNER long dark assault rifle, LEFT forearm HI-32 BU-TT/A blue-white pulse blade, compact four-tube missile pod over RIGHT shoulder. Never substitute a humanoid pilot, Gundam face, bright superhero armor, winged robot or fantasy sword. Polished detailed painted anime-mecha rendering with crisp readable silhouette and realistic hard surface armor, at least reference quality. Transparent background, NO text, labels, numbers, panels, borders, targets, terrain, cast shadows or attached attack effects. EXACTLY 24 separated complete full-body sprites in a STRICT regular 6-column by 4-row grid, uniform cell dimensions, ample transparent margin. Every cell has one robot only, same anatomy/armor and same body scale. Side-view 3/4 poses suitable for a side-scrolling fighter, primarily facing RIGHT. Row-major poses: row1: 0 neutral standing rifle lowered feet grounded; 1 walking step; 2 sprint with forward lean; 3 low crouch; 4 confident communication gesture; 5 recoiling from a light hit. Row2: 6 forward rifle-butt jab; 7 returning elbow strike; 8 upward booster uppercut with LEFT arm raised; 9 long horizontal LEFT pulse-blade slash with arm fully extended to RIGHT (blade hilt present, no light trail); 10 midair spinning blade sweep; 11 crouching low blade sweep to RIGHT. Row3: 12 powerful forward charged blade thrust; 13 upward smash kicking booster pose; 14 looking BACK LEFT and striking rearward with RIGHT elbow; 15 overhead LEFT-arm blade sweep in midair; 16 descending forward diagonal LEFT blade chop; 17 reaching RIGHT with LEFT hand to grab. Row4: 18 close elbow pummel; 19 pushing/throwing forward RIGHT; 20 defensive ready stance; 21 airborne knockback tumble; 22 knocked down on side; 23 victory standing with rifle held aloft. Keep complete feet, rifle, head and shoulder launcher inside each cell. Hard mechanical joints, not stretchy. Do not repaint or include the original page layout. Large landscape atlas, preferably 1536x1024 or larger.

prompts.Effects: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent VFX atlas for C4-621 / Armored Core VI LOADER 4 fighting game. Reference image is visual vocabulary only. Create EXACTLY 12 isolated high-detail painted game effect sprites in STRICT 3 columns x 4 rows uniform grid on real TRANSPARENT background. NO robot, character, human, hands, gun, scenery, text, symbols/letters, labels, borders or baked black/gray rectangles. Ample empty transparent gutters. Row-major: row1 0 small hot orange rifle tracer projectile traveling RIGHT, elongated with trailing glow to left; 1 bright orange rifle muzzle flash pointing RIGHT; 2 single dark steel missile with orange engine flame to LEFT, nose pointing RIGHT. Row2 3 rounded fiery orange explosion with gray smoke (radial); 4 sweeping broad blue-white pulse blade crescent leading to RIGHT and trailing to LEFT; 5 compact intense blue-white thrust blade streak going RIGHT. Row3 6 orange-white booster flame jet trailing LEFT with motion toward RIGHT; 7 blue-white quick boost curved speed streak traveling RIGHT; 8 bright sharp white-gold metal impact spark radial. Row4 9 red electric ACS overload arc radial without any text/UI; 10 translucent spherical blue-white pulse guard shield; 11 gray-white landing dust plume with scattered mechanical debris flecks, radial. Highly polished luminous effects with soft transparent edges, readable at small size, similar or better quality than the reference. Shapes remain separate, no large trails crossing grid cells. Prefer landscape 1536x1024.
prompts.Portrait: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: character-selection portrait for a 2D platform fighting game. Images 1 and 2 are DESIGN REFERENCES only. Render one highly polished detailed LOADER 4 C4-621 from Armored Core VI, matching approved sprites exactly: weathered warm off-white gray industrial angular armor, dark graphite mechanical joints, small rectangular orange sensor head (no human face), massive shoulder plates, mechanical core, right shoulder compact four-tube missile launcher, right-hand long TURNER rifle, blue-white left forearm pulse blade. Dramatic but readable three-quarter battle-ready upright pose facing slightly RIGHT, centered head/upper torso in upper half, both shoulders fully visible, weapon portions lower sides. Frame from head to upper thighs, avoid extreme closeup or small distant robot. Fine chipped paint, layered armor edges and orange lenses, premium painted mecha illustration, reference quality or higher. Truly transparent background, isolated robot only. No text, labels, watermark, environment, ground, shadows or frame. Prefer 1024x1024 square.
